steps: Create a folder named `first-page`. Inside it, create index.html, styles.css, and script.js. Before adding code, write one sentence explaining the job of each file.
Copy the HTML starter into index.html, save it, and open the file in your browser. Confirm that you can see the page title, heading, paragraph, callout, and button.
Copy the CSS and JavaScript starters into their named files. Reload the page, confirm the callout is styled, click the button, and confirm its text changes.
Change one CSS or JavaScript filename in index.html so the browser cannot find it. Reload, observe what stops working, inspect the browser console or Network panel, then restore the correct filename.
Write a short debug note stating what you broke, what browser evidence you saw, why it failed, and how you confirmed the repair.
